title: DeathMeter
description: Adds a persistent per-player life meter with PvP rewards, death penalties, automatic bans at zero, and simple admin controls for high-stakes survival servers.
body:
# DeathMeter

Bring real consequences to your server with **DeathMeter** — a simple and persistent life meter system for **Paper 1.21.1**.

Each player has their own meter. They can earn lives by killing other players in PvP, lose lives on death, and once their meter reaches **0**, they are automatically **kicked and banned**.

DeathMeter is built for servers that want a clean **life-based survival or PvP mechanic** without bloated features or difficult setup.

## Main features

- Persistent per-player life meter
- Configurable starting lives, max value, kill reward, death penalty, and ban reason
- Automatic punishment when a player runs out of meter
- Admin commands for full meter control
- Reliable save-to-disk storage
- Designed for simple survival and high-stakes gameplay

## Default setup

- Start with **3** lives
- **+1** for PvP kills
- **-2** on death
- Ban at **0** lives

## Commands

- `/meter get`
- `/meter set`
- `/meter add`
- `/meter reset`
- `/meter revive`
- `/meter reload`

## Perfect for

- hardcore survival servers
- PvP-focused servers
- competitive SMPs
- limited-life events

DeathMeter keeps the system easy to understand for players while giving admins enough control to tune the experience for their server.
